gates.title: Readiness summary has no runtime side effects
gates.evidence: This summary reads archived artifacts only; it does not contact Docker, NAS, Windows Runner, Admin API, or Cutter API.

gates.title: Docker candidate smoke has passed locally or in GitHub
gates.required_evidence: Run validate:admin-docker-local-smoke on a Docker-capable machine, or archive an Admin Docker GitHub artifact readiness report with github_candidate_artifact_ready=true.

gates.title: Live NAS Docker read-only blockers are clear
gates.evidence: No effective live-readonly upload blockers reported. Raw live blockers: admin-worker-live-flags, cutter-release-compatibility-live
gates.required_evidence: Rerun the GET-only live-readonly probe after the staged target exposes current endpoints and live gates pass.

gates.title: Docker version/API parity blockers are clear
gates.evidence: No effective parity upload blockers reported. Raw parity blockers: admin-worker-env-external-proof, cutter-compatibility-external-proof
gates.required_evidence: Current Admin API contract, disk risk, worker proof, and Cutter proof blockers must be cleared.

gates.title: admin-worker env proof is accepted
gates.required_evidence: Provide accepted NAS admin-worker env and inspect proof.

gates.title: Cutter compatibility proof is accepted
gates.required_evidence: Provide accepted staged-candidate Windows Cutter compatibility proof.

gates.title: NAS release-input returned evidence has been consumed
gates.required_evidence: Run the NAS collector, copy admin-docker-release-inputs/ back locally, then run intake:admin-docker-nas-release-inputs until intake_complete=true.

gates.title: NAS release-input collection path is prepared
gates.evidence: returned evidence has already been consumed by intake
gates.required_evidence: Provide a direct NAS collection path or a ready portable handoff kit before waiting on returned NAS evidence.

gates.title: NAS handoff kit is ready for manual transfer
gates.evidence: returned evidence has already been consumed by intake
gates.required_evidence: Run package:admin-docker-nas-handoff-kit and require kit_ready=true plus a sha256-pinned .tar.gz archive.

gates.title: Returned NAS evidence precheck passed inside intake
gates.required_evidence: Regenerate intake with a current script that records observations.returned_precheck_passed=true before release review.

gates.title: Release inputs are ready for a separate release decision
gates.required_evidence: Release inputs must be regenerated from accepted pre-staging, candidate-ref, and NAS current-image proof.

gates.title: Docker staging runbook is ready for release review
gates.required_evidence: Regenerate the staging runbook after explicit tags and evidence gates are satisfied.

gates.title: Push decision package is prepared when image push is the remaining staging execution blocker
gates.required_evidence: Generate prepare:admin-docker-push-decision-package before asking a release owner to review push_images=true.

gates.title: Summary does not approve Docker upload by itself
gates.required_evidence: Docker upload must remain a separate release decision even when evidence gates are ready.

reasons_requiring_external_action: Explicit release approval is still required before push_images=true or staging execution.
safe_local_next_actions: Refresh read-only evidence summaries, release-readiness summaries, and documentation from archived artifacts.
Use the prepared push decision package as the release-owner review handoff; it does not approve image push by itself.
blocked_actions: Do not run the Admin Docker workflow with push_images=true.
Do not mark Admin Docker MVP v0.1 complete.

result.summary: Docker release review remains blocked by archived evidence gates.

next_actions: Have the release owner review the prepared Admin Docker push decision package; only after explicit approval, run its exact push_images=true workflow command and then set MIXLAB_DOCKER_PUSH_APPROVAL=workflow_dispatch:push_images=true for the staging runbook.
